summary_en: Japanette Holdings has withdrawn its proposal to acquire all outstanding shares of Twinbird Corporation through a tender offer aimed at making Twinbird a wholly owned subsidiary. Twinbird's board had expressed opposition to the proposal on August 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Withdrawal of Proposal for Tender Offer for Shares of Twinbird Corporation by Japanette Holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On June 19, 2026, Twinbird Corporation announced that Japanette Holdings Corporation had proposed a tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Twinbird with the purpose of making Twinbird a wholly owned subsidiary. On August 31, 2026, Twinbird's board of directors expressed opposition to the proposal through a board resolution. On September 2, 2026, Japanette published a statement in response to Twinbird's opposition, which Twinbird interpreted as clarifying that Japanette was withdrawing the proposal. This notice, dated September 4, 2026, formally announces the withdrawal.

Twinbird views the proposal process as a meaningful opportunity to reconsider its management challenges and growth strategy from multiple angles. The company acknowledged that Japanette had focused on Twinbird's technological capabilities, product development strength, and the value of manufacturing originating from Tsubame-Sanjo. Going forward, Twinbird intends to leverage insights gained from the proposal review process and execute measures based on its new medium-term business plan for 2026-2030, announced on August 31, 2026, to enhance corporate value as a listed company and meet the expectations of shareholders and other stakeholders.
